fields.ruling: Tracking and approaching free-roaming wild animals is allowed, including the incidental Nimble XP awarded by the game. Do not trap, collect, or contain wild animals to create a repeatable Nimble XP farm.
fields.title: Trapped-animal Nimble farming

fields.guidance: Enclosed fence or window areas built for fighting must leave at least three tiles between opposing sides. Separate fence or window walls must leave at least two tiles between them. Ordinary base construction is not covered by this ruling.
fields.ruling: Fence and window combat is allowed, including the use of structures found in the world. Gridded structures built specifically for combat are not allowed.
fields.title: Combat-built fence and window grids

fields.guidance: A location's first spawn and ordinary returns are allowed. Purposefully using vehicles, noise, repeated departures, or other methods to manufacture zombies or their loot is banned.
fields.ruling: Do not deliberately de-virtualize or repeatedly regenerate zombies to force valuable or location-specific spawns.
fields.title: Purposeful zombie force-spawning

fields.guidance: Ordinary differences between displays are tolerated, but combining visibility manipulation with darkness or fast-forward behaviour to bypass danger is an exploit.
fields.ruling: Avoid deliberately boosting gamma, black levels, or a monitor's shadow setting to gain visibility that the game does not provide.
fields.title: Boosting black levels to see at night

fields.guidance: Remove any suspect bait and preserve evidence if the incident affects a run. Deliberate duplication is not permitted.
fields.ruling: If bait appears to remain usable after its source item disappears, do not repeat or compound the behaviour.
fields.title: Trap bait duplication

fields.ruling: Do not trigger sleep while holding Run against a wall, bed, corner, or other obstruction in order to keep earning Running XP while asleep. Deliberately creating this state is prohibited.
fields.title: Running skill abuse

fields.content: One survivor. One world. No exploits. Every official result backed by evidence.

Start through the official Great Spiffo's Rat Race challenge mode. You may choose any occupation and any valid combination of character traits. Each attempt uses one survivor in one world. You may begin another attempt after a run ends, subject to the active-run limit shown by the website.

A winning survivor must reach Level 10 in all 35 player skills, complete all 13 published outpost objectives, and record 1,000,000 zombie kills. The website calculates progress from approved run data. Completing only part of the objective still earns a place in the race, but it is not a win.

The Rat Race mod is required. Other mods may be used only when the [Mods catalogue](/mods/) lists them as Allowed or Required. Disallowed, Pending, and unlisted mods cannot be used in an official run. Submit an unlisted mod for review before adding it to your game.

Avoid exploits as far as reasonably possible. Do not deliberately duplicate resources, bypass challenge requirements, manipulate recorded statistics, or use another unintended advantage. Review the [Exploits section](/exploits/) for published guidance and specific rulings. Public rulings apply consistently to everyone, even when an exploit exists in the base game.

Debug tools are not part of ordinary play. They may be used only to recover from a lethal or run-ending game bug that can be shown not to be player error. Preserve evidence of the incident and the smallest corrective action taken, then disclose it with the submission. A moderator decides whether the recovered run remains valid.

Keep a Twitch or YouTube broadcast of the run wherever broadcast evidence is required. Select the relevant broadcast when submitting and add supporting clips when they help a moderator verify a milestone, unusual event, recovery, or death. Evidence must belong to the connected channel on your account.

Submit the export produced by the current Rat Race mod. The website verifies its integrity and stores each submission unchanged for review. A run becomes official only when its first submission is approved. Later approved submissions advance the official record; pending or declined submissions do not.

A survivor death ends the attempt. Submit the final export so the run can be recorded as Deceased. You may instead abandon an active run from your dashboard; abandonment is irreversible and releases that challenge slot. A completed run remains subject to evidence and moderation like any other result.

Moderators review evidence, exports, declared recovery actions, and published rulings. They may approve, decline, or invalidate a result when the evidence does not support it. Ask rules questions publicly in the Discord discussions area so the answer can help every racer. Do not seek private rulings by direct message.
When in doubt, ask before acting.

The current website rules, mod catalogue, and published team rulings govern official Stable Rat Race runs. Historical Unstable material is preserved for context but does not override the current rules.

fields.content: Published rulings for unintended mechanics that can affect an official Rat Race run.
Do not trigger sleep while holding Run against a wall, bed, corner, or other obstruction in order to keep earning Running XP while asleep. Deliberately creating this state is prohibited.

Tracking and approaching free-roaming wild animals is allowed, including the incidental Nimble XP awarded by the game. Do not trap, collect, or contain wild animals to create a repeatable Nimble XP farm.

Do not deliberately de-virtualize or repeatedly regenerate zombies to force valuable or location-specific spawns. A location's first spawn and ordinary returns are allowed. Purposefully using vehicles, noise, repeated departures, or other methods to manufacture zombies or their loot is banned.

Fence and window combat is allowed, including the use of structures found in the world. When building specifically to fight zombies, enclosed fence or window areas must leave at least three tiles between opposing sides, and separate fence or window walls must leave at least two tiles between them. Gridded combat structures are not allowed. Ordinary base construction is not covered by this ruling.

If bait appears to remain usable after its source item disappears, do not repeat or compound the behaviour. Remove any suspect bait and preserve evidence if the incident affects a run. The reported potato case could not be reproduced and may have involved the item's remaining bait uses, but deliberate duplication is not permitted.
Boosting black levels to see at night

Avoid deliberately boosting gamma, black levels, or a monitor's shadow setting to gain visibility that the game does not provide. Ordinary differences between displays are tolerated, but combining visibility manipulation with darkness or fast-forward behaviour to bypass danger is an exploit.

fields.content: When in doubt, ask before acting.

These published rulings apply to official Stable Rat Race runs. Discovering an exploit accidentally does not automatically invalidate a run: stop, do not compound it, preserve evidence, and disclose it with your submission.
